items.title: Accenture (ACN) Pushes Deeper Into Regulatory Data With AI And Real Time Risk Monitoring
items.summary: Accenture (NYSE:ACN) is expanding its role in the global regulatory data market using AI, cloud tools and real time risk monitoring.
